title: AI Scenario Tester
description:
The AI Scenario Tester evaluates the logic and consistency of automated systems to support our advisory work. This position provides the verification needed to maintain high standards of analytical rigor within our formal documentation.

About JHC Consulting
JHC Consulting is a private advisory practice that provides counsel to chief executives and board committees on decisions with significant consequences. The firm specializes in written analysis designed to remain on record long after a meeting concludes. Rather than delivering presentations or facilitating group consensus sessions, we produce memoranda that are authored and signed by a single individual. This philosophy rests on the conviction that a well reasoned, seven page document is more valuable than a forty page slide deck that only circles a question.
Working with clients managing governance transitions and strategic shifts, we prioritize absolute discretion and honesty. The work at JHC Consulting is precise. We favor clarity over volume and evidence over assumption. By focusing on the written record, we provide a stable foundation for the future of the organizations we serve. Every member of our team is expected to uphold this commitment to intellectual discipline.

In This Role
  • Designing prompts to test the accuracy and logical consistency of generative models.
  • Reviewing model outputs to identify failures in reasoning or factual accuracy.
  • Fact checking claims against primary source documents and historical records.
  • Drafting clear, concise descriptions of model limitations for use in client reports.
  • Organizing test cases into structured data sets for ongoing quality monitoring.
  • Collaborating with advisors to refine the analytical frameworks used in our memoranda.

What We Are Looking For
We require individuals who possess a calm temperament and a high degree of intellectual curiosity. This position is suited for someone who is naturally skeptical of automated outputs and has the patience to probe for errors. You need the ability to write in a way that is clear, direct, and free of unnecessary ornamentation. Precision matters more than speed in our workflow. You should be comfortable working in an environment that values deep focus and personal accountability. An ability to organize complex information into a coherent narrative is helpful. We value those who can think through a problem from multiple angles before presenting a conclusion. A background in the humanities or social sciences often provides a helpful foundation for this work. Candidates who have studied law, history, philosophy, or classics typically possess the analytical framework we require. Familiarity with generative models is useful, but we value core reasoning skills above specific technical certifications.

Working At JHC Consulting
This is a fully remote position that offers a significant amount of autonomy. We cultivate a work environment centered on deep work rather than frequent meetings. You will receive direct mentorship from advisors who value the quality of your thought. We provide the time necessary to do your job with excellence. This is an opportunity to contribute to high level advisory work while developing a disciplined approach to analysis. We offer a professional atmosphere where the focus remains entirely on the quality of the written record. Success in this role is measured by the clarity of your findings and the reliability of your research. This environment is ideal for those who prefer to think deeply before they write.
Our firm remains committed to the principle that honesty is the highest form of service. Every memorandum we produce reflects the individual accountability of its author. We seek individuals who are ready to uphold this standard and contribute to a body of work that withstands the test of time.

title: Manual Tester with Overlap into Automation
description:
Do you enjoy testing, know how to look at a product through the eyes of a user, and think critically about what could be done more efficiently? At Billdu, we are looking for someone who will primarily focus on manual testing, but who is also not afraid of automation, thinks systematically, and knows how to use AI tools where it makes sense.

We are not looking for someone who will just mechanically click through checklists. We are looking for someone who can think things through, ask the right questions, identify risks before they become problems, and while testing also think about what could be automated or improved in the future.

Our ideal combination is a strong manual tester with good product thinking, a technical mindset, and openness to AI and automation.

What would your job involve?

  • Manually testing our products across both mobile apps and the web.
  • Looking for bugs, UX shortcomings, unclear product behavior, and edge cases that others might miss.
  • Designing test scenarios and thinking about what makes the most sense to test, in what order, and why.
  • Collaborating with developers, product, and other team members so that issues are resolved quickly and sensibly.
  • Helping set up and improve QA processes so that testing is not only reactive, but also sustainable in the long term.
  • Looking at what could be automated over time and where automation would truly bring value.
  • Using AI tools as a helper in testing, scenario creation, risk analysis, documentation, or improving efficiency.


Employee benefits

  • You will join the team behind a global product and one of Slovakia’s most successful success stories.
  • The opportunity to influence what QA at Billdu will look like in the future.
  • We offer you a stable job with the possibility of partial work from home.
  • Fair compensation, a hardware allowance, and support for education.
  • We offer an environment where you can fully use your potential, with support for further learning and continuous development.
  • You will get a Multisport card for sports activities and relaxation.
  • You will have access to a game room, silent room, relax zone, and many other perks for your comfort.
  • You will get full access to Udemy and a Blinkist Premium account.
  • You will have access to the Hedepy zone and be entitled to one therapy session per month.
  • And lots of team-building activities ;)


Candidate requirements

  • You have experience with manual testing of mobile apps.
  • You can think independently and do not expect everything to be laid out for you step by step.
  • You have an eye for detail, but at the same time you know how to prioritize and do not get stuck on unimportant things.
  • You understand that a good tester does not just look for bugs, but helps improve the entire product.
  • You understand how test automation works or could work, even though this is not a purely automation-focused role.
  • You are not afraid of new tools and see AI as a practical helper.
  • You can communicate clearly, factually, and constructively.
  • You are comfortable using English in everyday work communication.

title: Manuálny tester/testerka s presahom do automatizácie
description:
Baví ťa testovanie, vieš sa na produkt pozrieť očami používateľa aj kriticky rozmýšľať nad tým, čo by sa dalo robiť efektívnejšie? Do Billdu hľadáme človeka, ktorý bude primárne riešiť manuálne testovanie, ale zároveň sa nezľakne automatizácií, rozmýšľa systémovo a vie si pomôcť AI nástrojmi tam, kde to dáva zmysel.


Nehľadáme človeka, ktorý bude len mechanicky odklikávať checklisty. Hľadáme niekoho, kto sa vie zamyslieť, pýta sa správne otázky, vie odhaliť riziká skôr, než sa stanú problémom a pri testovaní rozmýšľa aj nad tým, čo by sa dalo zautomatizovať alebo zlepšiť do budúcna.

Naša ideálna kombinácia je silný manuálny tester s dobrým produktovým uvažovaním, technickým mindsetom a otvorenosťou voči AI a automatizácii.


Aká by bola náplň tvojej práce?

  • Testovať naše produkty manuálne naprieč mobilnými appkami aj webom.
  • Hľadať bugy, UX nedostatky, nejasnosti v správaní produktu a edge cases, ktoré by iným možno ušli.
  • Navrhovať test scenáre a premýšľať nad tým, čo má najväčší zmysel testovať, v akom poradí a prečo.
  • Spolupracovať s developermi, produktom a ďalšími ľuďmi v tíme tak, aby sa problémy riešili rýchlo a rozumne.
  • Pomáhať nastavovať a zlepšovať QA procesy, aby testovanie nebolo len reakčné, ale dlhodobo funkčné.
  • Pozerať sa aj na to, čo by sa časom dalo automatizovať a kde automatizácia naozaj prinesie hodnotu.
  • Používať AI nástroje ako pomocníka pri testovaní, tvorbe scenárov, analýze rizík, dokumentácii alebo zefektívňovaní práce.


Aké benefity ponúkame?

  • Pridáš sa k tímu, ktorý stojí za globálnym produktom a jednou z najúspešnejších success story zo Slovenska.
  • Možnosť ovplyvniť, ako bude QA v Billdu vyzerať do budúcna.
  • Ponúkame ti stabilné pracovné miesto s možnosťou čiastočnej práce z domu.
  • Spravodlivé odmeny, príspevok na hardvér a vzdelávanie.
  • Máme prostredie, kde môžeš naplno využívať svoj potenciál, s podporou na ďalšie vzdelávanie a neustály rozvoj.
  • Dostaneš Multisport kartičku na športové aktivity a relax.
  • Budeš mať k dispozícii Game room, silent room, relax zone a mnoho ďalších vychytávok pre tvoje pohodlie.
  • Budeš mať full prístup k Udemy a dostaneš Blinkist premium account.
  • Budeš mať prístup do Hedepy zóny a nárok na jednu terapiu mesačne.
  • A veľa teambuildingových aktivít ;)


Aké sú naše požiadavky?

  • Máš skúsenosť s manuálnym testovaním mobilných appiek.
  • Vieš rozmýšľať samostatne a nečakáš, že všetko dostaneš presne nalinkované.
  • Máš cit pre detail, ale zároveň vieš odhadnúť priority a nezasekneš sa na nepodstatných veciach.
  • Rozumieš tomu, že dobrý tester nehľadá len bugy, ale pomáha zlepšovať celý produkt.
  • Máš prehľad o tom, ako fungujú alebo by mohli fungovať testovacie automatizácie, aj keď táto rola nie je čisto automation pozícia.
  • Nebojíš sa nových nástrojov a AI berieš ako praktickú pomoc.
  • Vieš komunikovať jasne, vecne a konštruktívne.
  • Angličtina ti nerobí problém pri bežnej pracovnej komunikácii.


Tešíme sa na tvoje CV! :)

title: Agile Test Engineer
description:

About the project:


As an AJO / ACO Tester, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution, quality, and reliability of our omnichannel marketing campaigns and customer journey orchestrations. You will be responsible for meticulously validating end-to-end user journeys, data ingestion, real-time segmentations, and automated triggers within Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and Adobe Campaign Orchestration (ACO).


What you’ll do:


  • Read solution designs, journey maps, campaign briefs, and data specs; translate them into clear, traceable test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
  • Design test scenarios that exercise the full surface area of an AJO journey or ACO campaign: entry conditions, segment qualification, branching logic, wait steps, channel sends, suppression, and exit criteria.
  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests against AJO journeys, ACO workflows, AEP datasets, and channel configurations.
  • Validate XDM schemas, identity stitching, profile fragments, and segment membership using AEP UI, Query Service, and APIs.
  • Run rendering tests across major email clients and devices using tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid; verify dynamic content, personalization, and fallback behavior.
  • Validate push, SMS, in-app, and code-based experiences end-to-end — from trigger event through delivery and tracking.
  • Reproduce, document, and triage defects with the level of detail a developer can act on immediately: inputs, expected vs. actual, screenshots, payloads, and logs.
  • Sign off on releases with a clear, defensible quality statement: what was tested, what was not, what risks remain.
  • Build and maintain automated checks for stable, high-value scenarios: API contract tests, schema validation, payload comparisons, and regression of core journey paths.
  • Work day-to-day with AJO / ACO Developers, solution architects, project managers, data engineers, and client marketing operations teams in an embedded or hybrid model.


What makes you a great fit:


  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ Years of experience working in software or marketing-platform QA.
  • 1+ Years of experience working with Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign Classic, or Adobe Campaign Standard implementations.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform: XDM schemas, datasets, identities, Real-Time Customer Profile, segmentation, and source/destination connectors.
  • Strong test design skills: equivalence partitioning, boundary analysis, scenario design, and risk-based prioritization applied to data• and event-driven systems.
  • Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs and JSON.
  • Comfortable using Postman or equivalent to exercise AJO/ACO and AEP endpoints.
  • Working scripting ability in JavaScript, Python, or similar.
  • Solid knowledge of email, push, SMS, and in-app channel mechanics: rendering, deliverability fundamentals, tracking, and personalization.
  • Familiarity with Git-based workflows, ticketing systems (Jira), and modern release practices for marketing-platform deployments.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.


Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍


For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.


We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

title: Junior Test Specialist/QA Engineer (f/m)
description:
Company Description

Netcompany was founded in 2000 and has its headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Today, we are an international company with more than 9000+ employees working from

10 locations. We serve a wide array of customers in their digital transformation journeys in the public and private sectors across Europe.

From assisting small businesses to undertaking significant government projects, our innovative IT solutions are making a difference. Our culture emphasizes agility and flexibility, with minimal bureaucracy. Look at some of our impactful projects here: https://netcompany.com/cases/

As we prepare for new ventures, we are seeking ambitious individuals to join us on this journey.

Continue your development with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and assist you in achieving your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague ensures your well-being and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Furthermore, you will participate in our training program, Netcompany Academy, where you will be offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies, and management to communication. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, which ensures that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your expertise, allowing you to be well-prepared to handle various tasks and continually improve throughout your career with us.

Job Description

We are team players. We change societies by creating life-changing IT solutions for a variety of customers – from small private companies to large projects in the public sector. Our culture builds on low bureaucracy with a strong focus on high agility and flexibility. We are looking for Test Automation Specialist/QA Engineer to join us in this adventure.

Work tasks and technologies

Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our customers. You will be involved in testing mission-critical IT systems that are important not only to our public or private sector customers but to people across society.

You will always be part of a project team with colleagues from Netcompany. You will continuously develop your professional and technical testing skills. Throughout the projects, you will gain access to a wide range of the latest technologies and tools. Your primary tasks will include:

  • Assuring solution quality through various types of testing
  • Analyzing both functional and non-functional aspects of the solution
  • Designing and documenting comprehensive test cases
  • Executing functional, non-functional, and regression tests
  • Developing test strategies and detailed test plans
  • Contributing to defect troubleshooting and test reporting

About You

You can work methodically and connect the dots between business and IT technical issues, and you can explain business needs to developers and technical aspects to the customer. Additionally, we imagine that you:

  • Are able to see through complex error scenarios and can manage complex system landscapes
  • Are systematic and detail-oriented in the analysis, design, development, and testing phases
  • Think logically and analytically, are able to break down and understand complex concepts, and can communicate problems and deficiencies clearly and distinctly
  • Thrive with a methodical and structured approach to tasks

Qualifications

  • Master's degree within a relevant IT or STEM specialization OR Bachelor's degree with minimum 1 year of relevant commercial experience after graduation.
  • Willingness to cooperate directly with external customers
  • Very good command of English, both spoken and written
  • Strong teamwork & communication skills
  • Ability to design test cases and test scenarios independently
  • Solid understanding of SDLC, testing methodologies and test types (both functional and non-functional)

Nice to have

  • Basic experience in test automation (writing or maintaining automated tests).
  • Basic knowledge of API testing tools (e.g. Postman).
  • Basic knowledge of SQL for data validation.
  • Experience with test management tools (e.g. TestRail).

Additional Information

Continue your development with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional growth.

From your first day, you’ll be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you in your development and help you reach your goals. This close relationship with an experienced colleague ensures well-being while also giving you valuable insight into the many career opportunities that open up as you gain experience.

Be a part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we prioritize community highly. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture that is built on collaboration and trust, and where there is always room for mutual sparring and support.

It is part of our culture and values that all employees, irrespective of backgrounds, identities, and experiences, are met with understanding and respect, as well as equal opportunities for development and well-being.

You will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate with colleagues from various cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices in many countries.

We provide a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we offer a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Our perks and benefits:

  • Scandinavian work environment
  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Multisport Card
  • English and Danish language lessons
  • Drinks, snacks & fruit available at the office
  • Career development program for each employee and regular feedback
  • International cooperation with colleagues from Denmark, the Netherlands, Norway, the UK, Greece and Vietnam
  • Attractive offices with a great location in Warsaw: Puławska 180 (Metro Wilanowska) and Wronia 10 (Metro Rondo Daszyńskiego)

Send us your application

Please upload your CV to our recruitment system via the link. If you haven't received answers to all your questions, feel free to reach out to pl.hr@netcompany.com

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email HR at pl.hr@netcompany.com for assistance.

All qualified candidates are invited to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disabilities, age, religion and beliefs, political beliefs, nationality, ethnic or social background.

Manual QA Tester with Aviation Domain Knowledge - Flight Deck Application

We are looking for a Manual QA Tester with strong aviation domain knowledge to support the development of a Flight Deck application used in airline flight operations and pilot workflows. This role is a good fit for someone with hands-on aviation experience, for example as a pilot, flight operations specialist, dispatcher, EFB user, or aviation professional, who wants to grow into software quality assurance.

Previous testing experience is welcome but not the main requirement. The most important value for this role is understanding aviation workflows, pilot needs, flight deck operations, and how aviation software should behave in real operational scenarios.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform manual testing of the Flight Deck application across key pilot and operational workflows.
  • Validate that application behavior matches aviation use cases, user expectations, and operational logic.
  • Review features related to flight briefings, operational documents, weather data, checklists, navigation-related content, and integrations with flight-relevant tools.
  • Identify, document, and clearly communicate bugs, usability issues, and workflow inconsistencies.
  • Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and other QA team members.
  • Provide aviation-domain feedback to help the team build a more accurate and practical product.
  • Support exploratory testing based on real-life aviation scenarios.
  • Learn QA processes, test case design, defect reporting, and release validation.
  • Gradually develop skills toward test automation, including basic scripting, automated regression checks, or automation tools.


Requirements

  • Practical aviation knowledge or experience using flight deck, EFB, flight planning, briefing, or airline operations tools.
  • Understanding of pilot workflows, pre-flight preparation, in-flight needs, and post-flight operational processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to notice inconsistencies in application behavior.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to describe issues in a structured way.
  • Willingness to learn software testing practices.
  • Readiness to grow toward automated testing over time.
  • Good English skills for daily work in an international environment.
  • Curiosity, ownership, and a practical mindset.


Nice to Have

  • Experience as a pilot, student pilot, dispatcher, flight operations specialist, EFB administrator, or aviation software user.

  • Basic knowledge of QA tools, bug tracking systems, or test management tools.

This network strengthens grid stability - a critical foundation for scaling AI data centers and other energy-intensive industries.

As a Test Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring Fuse's hardware products and energy systems meet applicable regulatory, safety, and performance requirements throughout their lifecycle. You will work hands-on with prototypes and deployed systems, collaborating closely with hardware, firmware, software, and operations teams to translate regulatory requirements into practical, testable engineering outcomes.

In this role, you will be directly involved in design validation, certification, and end-of-line verification, navigating a broad regulatory landscape including electrical safety, EMC, grid connection standards, and environmental compliance.

  • Design test equipment and software to perform automated test either in HIL testing or EOL verification at the production site

  • Proficiency with standard electrical test and measurement equipment, such as oscilloscopes, power analysers, multimeters, insulation testers, and data acquisition systems
  • Experience creating structured test plans, executing formal test procedures, and producing clear, high-quality technical documentation
  • Working knowledge of relevant standards and regulations, such as LVD, EMC, grid connection codes, and related EU/UK directives (or a strong ability to learn them quickly)

  • Biannual bonus scheme
  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs

  • Breakfast and dinner allowance for office based employees

title: QA Engineer
description:
About Air Apps

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger - and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal, in 2018 - and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco - we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.

Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.

Join us on this journey to redefine resource management - and change lives along the way.

The Role

As a QA Engineer at, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our mobile applications. You’ll focus on building robust automated tests and strengthening API testing processes while still performing hands-on functional validation when needed.

Working closely with developers, product managers, and designers, you’ll help identify issues early, expand test coverage, and implement scalable testing strategies that guarantee a smooth and stable user experience.

Your role will be essential in detecting bugs, verifying feature implementations, automating tests, and validating software stability before deployment.

  • This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.

Responsibilities

  • Perform manual testing on web and mobile applications to ensure a seamless user experience.
  • Perform API tests and automation using Postman.
  • Creating and maintaining Postman documentation.
  • Create and execute automated regression, functional, performance, and API tests.
  • Develop and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
  • Document and report bugs, working closely with developers to resolve issues.
  • Ensure feature compliance by validating product requirements against test results.
  • Identify edge cases, inconsistencies, and performance issues.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to improve software quality throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Provide clear and structured feedback to enhance product functionality and user experience.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to quality assurance best practices.

Requirements

  • Around 3+ years of experience in manual and functional testing.

title: Junior Quality Assurance / Test Engineer - Product Area Research & Sustainability
description:
Are you someone who genuinely cares about quality, loves understanding how complex systems fit together, and wants to make a real impact from the very start of your career? If you enjoy asking "why" as much as "how" - and you're ready to grow in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment - this could be the perfect next step for you.

About The Role

We are looking for a motivated and curious Junior Quality Assurance (QA) / Test Engineer to join our Product Area Research & Sustainability, part of Risk Management IT. In this role, you will be at the heart of ensuring the reliability, quality, and trustworthiness of digital products that support research, sustainability, and risk-informed decision-making across the organisation.

You will work closely with product managers, developers, data engineers, and business stakeholders in agile teams - gaining hands-on exposure to business-critical platforms and real-world risk and sustainability use cases. This is an excellent opportunity for someone at an early stage of their career who is eager to learn, grow, and build a strong foundation in quality engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to functional and exploratory testing of applications, data pipelines, and integrations within the product area
  • Design, execute, and document test cases based on requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Collaborate closely with developers and product managers to identify, analyse, and clearly describe defects
  • Help ensure end‑to‑end quality across systems by understanding upstream and downstream dependencies
  • Contribute to maintaining and improving test documentation, test data, and quality standards
  • Leverage modern tooling, including AI-assisted techniques where appropriate, to improve test design, coverage, and efficiency
  • Participate in agile ceremonies (planning, reviews, retrospectives) and actively contribute a quality perspective
  • Gradually build an understanding of business processes and domain concepts to improve test coverage and relevance

About The Team

The Research & Sustainability product area is a dynamic, cross-functional part of Risk Management IT at Swiss Re. Rather than operating as a single dedicated team, we work as a collaborative community of shared resources - bringing together diverse skills and perspectives across a broad technology stack to deliver impactful solutions.

We support a wide range of critical platforms and products serving Group Risk Management, Group Underwriting, and the Swiss Re Institute - enabling data-driven decision-making, risk analytics, and sustainability insights at scale. Our work sits at the intersection of technology, research, and business impact, making quality engineering a truly meaningful and visible function within the area.

About You

You care deeply about quality and take pride in helping teams deliver reliable, meaningful products. You're not just looking for bugs - you understand that great testing is about building confidence in systems and enabling teams to move forward with clarity. You're curious, structured in your thinking, and comfortable raising concerns early. You thrive in collaborative environments and are excited by the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers while contributing your own perspective from day one.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements

  • Basic understanding of software development lifecycles and agile ways of working
  • Ability to think analytically and structured, with strong attention to detail
  • Curiosity and willingness to understand how systems work end‑to‑end, not only single components
  • Good communication skills and confidence to ask questions and raise quality concerns early

These Are Additional Nice To Haves

  • Basic knowledge of SQL, APIs, or data‑centric applications
  • Exposure to test management tools
  • First experience with test automation concepts or scripting (not mandatory)
  • First experience with C# and/or TypeScript
  • Interest in risk management, insurance, reinsurance, or data‑driven platforms

Role

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1,800 and EUR 2,900 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

  • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
  • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.

Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Was Sie Mitbringen Sollten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Das Bieten Wir Ihnen

  • Angenehmes und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld

title: Software Test Engineer (M/F/D)*
description:
Fancy moving tasks? Our software solutions control hardware and help our customers worldwide to get their goods to their destination reliably and on time. As a Software Test Engineer (m/f/d) you are part of our agile teams and ensure that our customers are satisfied customers. Join our team in Regensburg or Teunz.

What you'll be handling:

  • You create the test case specifications and define the test scenarios based on the requirements.
  • You review functional specifications and the solution design and integrate the software components into an overall system.
  • You support commissioning on site and experience live how our systems come to life.
  • You work in international, distributed teams with an agile scrum approach.

What you'll need:

  • You are highly motivated, curious and willing to familiarize yourself with new topics.
  • You already have experience in manual and/or automated software testing of complex applications.
  • You work independently, have a high level of quality awareness and are willing to travel internationally around 70 days a year.
  • You are fluent in written and spoken German and English and can communicate effortlessly in an international context.
  • Knowledge of Java, SQL, agile development (Jira), Confluence and Testrail is not a must, but an advantage.
  • Career changers are also welcome and will receive comprehensive training.

What you'll receive:

  • An appreciative working environment, motivated team and an open feedback culture
  • Wide variety of tasks and room for creativity
  • A reliable and stable employer based on the philosophy "Focusing on People – Learning and Growing"
  • Team events to strengthen our sense of community
  • A well-structured training period and support by experienced colleagues
  • A permanent position with attractive compensation, 30 days of vacation, and 13 monthly salaries

title: SPS-Programmierer Mobile Robotics (m/w/d)
description:
4am Robotics - Autonomous Mobile Robots

Wir sind 4am Robotics - der Spezialist für autonome mobile Roboter (AMR) für die Intralogistik. Produktübergreifende Technik und Software treffen bei uns auf ein heterogenes Portfolio, das den Warenfluss flexibel, sicher und allzeit verfügbar von Ende zu Ende automatisiert und Komplexität reduziert. So können die Lösungen vom autonomen Routenzug über mobile Cobots bis hin zum autonomen Gabelstapler innerhalb kürzester Zeit automatisiert und softwareseitig beim Kunden implementiert werden.

Deine Aufgaben, Die Dich In Deinem Neuen Job Erwarten

Als SPS-Programmierer Mobile Robotik (m/w/d) bist Du für die Erstellung von SPS-Programmen und Visulisierungen zuständig. Von der Konzeptionierung, Projektierung bis hin zur Inbetriebnahme betreust Du die hardwarenahe Entwicklung für unsere autonomen mobilen Roboter und bist Ansprechpartner dafür am Standort sowie beim Kunden. Außerdem wirkst Du bei Dokumentationen und Kundenschulungen mit und bist eine zentrale Stütze für den Erfolg unserer Projekte.

Neben unserem Standort in Plattling ist auch eine Beschäftigung in Leinfelden-Echterdingen möglich.

Deine Qualifikationen, Die Du Dafür Mitbringen Solltest

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik, Mechatronik oder Elektrotechnik (ggf. mit Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker) oder auch abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Mechatronik oder Elektrotechnik
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Siemens TIA-Portal (S7-1500, WinCC)
  • Know-How über Sicherheitstechnik, Bus- und Antriebssysteme wünschenswert
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Offenheit für innovative Themen und Teamfähigkeit

Deine Benefits, die wir Dir im Gegenzug dafür anbieten:

  • Außergewöhnlicher Zusammenhalt & familiäres Miteinander
  • Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell
  • Abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet
  • 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr
  • Sonderzahlungen & betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Internes Prämienprogramm "Profis kennen Profis"
  • Wir setzen auf Weiterbildung und Qualifikation

title: Development Engineer (w/m/d)
description:
System Software

Als führendes deutsches System­­haus für Luft­ver­tei­digung, Lenk­flug­körper und Laser­techno­logie entwickeln wir heute die Lösungen gegen die Bedrohungen von morgen und bringen Spitzentechnologie zur Serienreife. Unsere Systeme über­zeugen in den Grenzbereichen der Physik durch hohe Präzision, sichern militärische Überlegenheit und garantieren damit politische Handlungsfähigkeit. MBDA bietet Ihnen ein einzigartiges und herausforderndes Umfeld, das von Spitzenleistung geprägt ist. Bei uns finden Sie eine Atmosphäre, die Lernen zulässt, Entwicklungen fördert und Möglichkeiten bietet, einen wertvollen Beitrag zu leisten. Vertrauen und Respekt bilden dabei das Fundament unserer partnerschaftlichen Zusammenarbeit. Wir achten aufeinander, erkennen den Wert, den eine vielfältige und integrative Belegschaft mit sich bringt, und sind stolz auf das, was wir leisten. Werden auch Sie ein Teil der er­folg­reichen MBDA-Gruppe.

WAS SIE BEITRAGEN KÖNNEN

  • Sie möchten gerne an Softwareentwicklungen mitarbeiten?
  • Systemtests finden Sie spannend?
  • Sie haben gute Erfahrung in Rust/Ada/C++?

Perfekt! Dann könnte diese Stelle Ihr nächster Karriereschritt als Entwicklungsingenieur (w/m/d) sein! Lesen Sie weiter…

Mit Ihrer Erfahrung, Ihrem Know-how Und Ihrer Leidenschaft Können Sie Sich Bei Den Folgenden Themen Und Aufgaben Bei Uns Einbringen

  • Durchführung von Software-Entwicklungsarbeiten in den Disziplinen Spezifikation, Architektur/Design, Implementierung, Test und Integration
  • Pflege, Änderung und Erweiterung der Systemsoftware eines eingeführten Flugkörper-Systems
  • Unterstützung der Qualifikation und Freigabe der Systemsoftware und des Gesamtsystems
  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung und Pflege notwendiger technischer Dokumentation
  • Vorbereitung und Unterstützung von Systemtests sowohl im Labor als auch bei Kampagnen
  • Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Demonstratoren und Konzepten zur Darstellung zukünftiger Systemfähigkeiten
  • Mitwirkung bei internen Forschungs- und Entwicklungstätigkeiten der Abteilung

mehr weniger

WAS SIE DAFÜR MITBRINGEN SOLLTEN

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches Studium im Bereich Informatik, Technische Informatik, Soft-ware-Engineering, Mathematik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Gute Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in allen Phasen der Softwareentwicklung
  • Gute Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in der Programmierung mit Rust/Ada/C++
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit gängigen Toolumgebungen, Frameworks und Abläufen in der Softwareentwicklung
  • Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in der Anwendung einschlägiger Software-Entwicklungsprozesse (z. B. V-Modell, agile Prozesse)
  • Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis verbunden mit der Fähigkeit, sich in bestehende Systeme einzuarbeiten
  • Fähigkeit zur Analyse von Problemen und Erarbeitung von Lösungen unter Berücksichtigung von System-, Software- und Hardware-Aspekten
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Engagierte, strukturierte und proaktive Denk- und Arbeitsweise
  • Flexibilität, gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

MBDA unterstützt Ihr persönliches Wachstum mit einem individuellen Entwicklungsplan. Damit schaffen wir für Sie eine persönliche Karriereperspektive.

title: Techniker Bildverarbeitung (m/w/d)
description:
What To Expect
Tesla steht für die Beschleunigung des Übergangs zu nachhaltiger Energie. Innerhalb weniger Jahre wurden revolutionäre Strategien und Produkte entwickelt und erfolgreich auf den Markt gebracht. Dies ist nur möglich durch außerordentliche Begeisterung und Identifikation der Mitarbeiter, Geschwindigkeit in der Umsetzung von Prozessen und Projekten sowie überdurchschnittlicher Innovationskraft und Effizienz.

Wir, Tesla Automation, unterstützen die unglaubliche Erfolgsgeschichte von Tesla durch hochautomatisierte Spitzentechnologie, welche die weltweite Produktionskapazität des Unternehmens auf das nächste Level hebt. Unsere Passion, Motivation und Leistungsbereitschaft für komplexen Sondermaschinenbau ermöglicht Tesla seine ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen.

Nun möchten wir mit Dir diese Erfolgsgeschichte fortführen und weiter etablieren.

What You'll Do

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Installation & Inbetriebnahme der vorbereiteten Bildverarbeitungssoftware.
  • Zusätzlich optimierst Du die Bildverarbeitungsapplikationen und unterstützt bei der Fehlersuche in Hard- & Software.
  • Auch die Umsetzung der notwendigen technischen Untersuchungen für die Entwicklung von neuen Bildverarbeitungsapplikationen gehört in Dein Aufgabenfeld.
  • Zudem bereitest Du Versuche vor und führst diese, inklusiver deren Auswertung, durch.
  • Abschließend erstellst Du Dokumentationen & Bedienungsanleitungen oder wirkst unterstützend mit.


    • What You'll Bring

  • Deine Basis bildet eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (Informations-, Automatisierungstechnik, Industrieinformatik) oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung in dem entsprechenden Bereich.
  • Von Vorteil könnte sich eine relevante Weiterbildung (z. B. Techniker) auswirken.
  • Des Weiteren bringst Du erste Kenntnisse in der Programmierung mit.
  • Du begeisterst uns mit Deiner großen Bereitschaft (inter-)national reisen zu wollen sowie mit Deinen guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen.
  • Abgerundet wird Dein Profil als Teamplayer durch Deine gute Fähigkeit mit in- und externen Ansprechpartnern zu kommunizieren sowie Deiner organisierten & selbständigen Arbeitsweise.

title: R&D
description:
Due to our high growth and commitment to technology, Medacta is seeking for a C++ Software Developer to join our development team. This team is responsible for creating preoperative planning software for orthopaedic surgeries. Specifically, we are seeking a developer to contribute to our desktop application for surgical planning. The ideal candidate will have experience in developing applications in C++ and specific expertise in QT, VTK, and ITK technologies, with a strong inclination toward 3D graphics. You will join a talented, young and dynamic software development team.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the following activities:

  • develop, test, and maintain C++ software applications focused on medical device functionality and surgical planning tools;
  • collaborate with regulatory, marketing, and project management teams to ensure alignment with industry regulations, product requirements, and project goals;
  • ensure compliance with medical device software standards (e.g., IEC 62304) and maintain thorough documentation for regulatory audits and submissions;
  • conduct code reviews and enforce best practices for code quality, documentation, and testing within the team;
  • contribute to risk analysis and usability assessments, working closely with cross-functional teams to address and mitigate potential issues;
  • provide technical support during clinical evaluations and product testing, addressing feedback and making iterative improvements;
  • continuously monitor and integrate relevant updates to software libraries, technologies, and industry standards to enhance software performance and security.

Hard Skills

The resource should also have the following skills:

  • bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering;
  • experience in medical device software development, with a proven record of designing or supporting software that meets regulatory requirement;
  • extensive experience with C++ programming, including hands-on experience with the Qt framework and CMake build systems;
  • strong background in 3D rendering software development;
  • solid understanding of linear algebra, including reference systems and transformation matrices;
  • proficiency with version control systems, particularly Git, and experience in a collaborative development environment;
  • experience with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker) to support deployment and testing processes;
  • knowledge of QML for the development of intuitive and responsive user interfaces;
  • experience working in cross-functional teams and managing input from regulatory, marketing, and project management perspectives.

Soft Skills

  • strong skills in planning, execution, and resource management across multiple projects;
  • excellent interpersonal and communication skills;
  • passion for writing great, simple, clean and efficient code;
  • awareness of the importance of the teamwork.

What We Offer

  • permanent contract;
  • flexible working hours;
  • carpooling organized by Medacta;
  • incentives for mobility by public transport;
  • advantageous conventions;
  • growth opportunity, working in a continuously improving and expanding environment;
  • annual salary review linked to performance and professional development;
  • continuous training.

Medacta International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

description:
Hi 👋🏾 I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. As someone who could design and build software, this position is close to my heart. I always felt I had a unique perspective because I could play with design ideas and iterate in code. My ideas could start in Figma but then be grounded (or sometimes more creative) in code. My prototypes used actual logic and data. My changes cascaded throughout the app for comprehensive critique (thanks, React component system!). But, every company made me pick one —I couldn’t design and build. At Ashby, you can.

While Every Engineer Can Design And Build, You’ll Tackle Our Most Challenging Design Problems And Help Others Improve Their Designs By Expanding And Enhancing Our In-house Design System And Consulting On Bespoke Work. To Ground It With Examples, Engineers Who Can Design At Ashby Have

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using it to make the wireframes a reality.
  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build custom autocompletes. These autocompletes can contain filters, options to create new records, etc.
  • Helped another engineer improve their design's information hierarchy and scannability for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

These projects reflect what we’re accomplishing at Ashby: improving the productivity of working professionals (starting with talent teams) with intelligent and powerful software. We put a lot of effort into designing products that are approachable to beginners but mastered & extended by power users. In many ways, spreadsheets set the bar here.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, over 2500 customers, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet, but you now probably have a good idea as to why we're hiring for this role 😅.

What We’re Building

As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.

Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 🥵 TA software didn’t help.

As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!

Engineering Culture

Our Engineering Culture Is Motivated By Benji’s (my Co-founder And CEO) And My Belief That a Small, Talented Team, Given The Right Environment, Can Build High-quality Software Fast (and Work Regular Hours!). We Do It Through

  • Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
  • Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
  • Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage
  • Putting effort into building a diverse team

Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership

The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They took customer problems and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.

Traditional product-development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But, consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”

At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, at Ashby, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do thrive.

Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate

Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here).

To Drive It Home, Here's a Recent Calendar Of An Engineer Who Has Been With Us For Over 4 Years. ~34 Hours Of Focus Time, 2.5h Of Interviews, And 3.5 Hours Of Meetings

We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region.

Increase Leverage, not Team Size

We Built Ashby With The Quality, Breadth, And Depth That Many Customers Would Expect From Much Larger Teams Over Larger Time Scales. We’ve Done This Through Investment In

  • Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 15x a day. A debugger that works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience 💪🏾.
  • Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) that we constantly improve. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).
  • AI-powered tooling. We think of AI as a way to automate the mundane parts of building and maintaining high-quality software. We use a combination of third-party and internally built tools that, for instance, auto-triage customer issues, suggest fixes, prototype ideas, generate production-ready code, and conduct code reviews. Engineers have an unlimited token budget (but are not measured on it).

And a Demo Of One Of These Building Blocks

Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:

Put Effort into Diversity

Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non-diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups.

Today, 25% of engineers and 50% of our engineering leaders at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. We are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.

Interview Process

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via pair programming, writing product and tech specs collaboratively, and talking through decisions. There are no leetcode or whiteboard exercises.

Our Interview Process Is Three Rounds

  • Introduction call with Hiring Manager (15 to 30m, live)
  • A technical screen where we pair in our actual codebase (1h, live)
  • Three non-coding interviews that focus on product thinking, technical design, and infrastructure (3h 15m, live can be split across multiple days)

Depending on our leadership team’s bandwidth, we may start with an additional 30m screen with a recruiter.

Your hiring manager will be your main point of contact and prep you for interviews. Each round will have written guidance so you know what to expect (you’ll need minimal preparation). You’ll meet 4 to 6 people in engineering (with 5-15 minutes in each interview to ask them questions). If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!

Your First Three Months at Ashby

We want an exceptional onboarding experience for every new hire. At Ashby, your dev environment is set up with a single script, you push your first product change on day one, and you spend the rest of your time shipping product changes that give you a tour of our codebase and best practices. The product changes increase in scope and ambiguity from simple copy changes to the delivery of a prominent, impactful feature. Your manager will do a 30, 60, and 90-day review to give feedback and calibrate on how we work together.

It’s a team effort to get you successfully onboarded; you’ll have a peer paired with you to answer questions, pair program, and check in often to see if you need help. The rest of the team will run training sessions on our culture, product, engineering process, and technical architecture.

Technology Stack

I’m sharing our tech stack with the caveat that we don’t require previous experience in it (but a love of typed languages is helpful 😀): TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, Redis.

When they joined Ashby, many of our engineers switched from other languages like Swift and Kotlin (Ben), platforms like iOS (Tom) and Windows (Sergey). We care more about fundamentals (e.g., debugging, abstractions) and how fast you learn. For folks on the team who switched, it's nice seeing changes hot reload versus waiting for XCode to compile 😅.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
  • A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Compensation Range: €141K - €226K

title: Test Engineer Electronics
description:
As a successful family-owned company on a path to global growth, the Brose Group offers challenging responsibilities and exciting career opportunities to performance-driven, skilled specialists with solid professional knowledge and proven career expertise who wish to contribute to our company’s success.

Your Tasks

  • Planning and organizing all necessary product validation tests for assigned projects
  • Independently conducting complex and non-standard tests; expanding the test portfolio and the team’s expertise
  • Independently drafting test reports, specifications, test plans, and standards
  • Creating test cases (TR0, TR1, TR2) within the timeframe set by customer projects
  • Technical review of customer specifications and providing feedback to the customer team for the purpose of creating proposals; negotiating test conditions with the customer and independently creating internal specifications
  • Independently analyzing components during product validation and optimizing development activities
  • Planning testing capacities for all assigned projects
  • Ensuring cost transparency for all project-related expenses; identifying planning discrepancies in the early stages and independently implementing corrective measures
  • Identifying and implementing cost- and time-saving measures within the testing and development team
  • Approving the test plan and presenting components to the customer and internal departments (e.g., component development, engine development, electronics development, calculation/simulation)
  • Presentation of test results to the customer, at internal meetings, or to other partners
  • Independent evaluation of test results after completion of the required tests
  • Commissioning and supervision of external service providers

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (preferably electronics/electrical engineering)
  • Position suitable for recent graduates.
  • Experience and knowledge in the field of automotive door systems is a plus
  • Experience and knowledge in project management and product development is a plus
  • Experience and knowledge of measurement and testing methods in the automotive industry is a plus
  • Expertise in electronic components and the use of electronic schematics.
  • Solution-oriented, proactive, and structured work style.
  • English – advanced level
  • German – intermediate level (an advantage, but not required)

We offer you a modern working environment with our Brose working world

Benefits

Financial benefits

  • Summer and winter bonus up to 700 €
  • Bonus 500 € - working anniversary after 5 years in Brose
  • Relocation contribution according to internal regulations
  • Bring a friend contribution
  • Financial reward for improvement proposals
  • Annual reward for reaching goals
  • Transport allowance (up to maximum of 80 €/month depending on distance between place of residence and workplace).
  • Child birth allowance in the amount of 150 € after working for 2 years
  • Contribution to supplementary pension saving - III. pillar

Non-financial benefits

  • Full flexible working time - healthy work-life balance
  • Social program benefit plus - additional contribution for leisure-time activities and health
  • Pleasant, modern working environment and supportive corporate culture
  • Wide career opportunities
  • Financial consultation
  • Legal consultation
  • Psychological consultation – Help Line (for family members as well)
  • Brose Kids Club (company nursery, kindergarten)

Education

  • E-learning educational programs - mylearning, Go1
  • Internal language courses: English, German and Slovak
  • Professional trainings in Slovakia or abroad
  • Training focused on soft skills and personal development

Salary

  • Salary (brutto): from1815 Eur/month
  • The salary consists of a basic wage from 1650 EUR + 10% of the variable components, which are paid on the basis of an internal regulation.
  • After fulfillment the internal criteria, there is possibility to obtain a summer and winter bonus (max. 2 x 700 Eur)

title: Test Engineer
description:
Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.

What We Offer

At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

Group Summary

Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Electronics, and we do it by creating world-class Electronic systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex Electronic systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Electronics.

Responsibilities

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design of electronics test sequences for the production of automotive camera systems
  • Creating test specifications
  • Assisting in the creation of test architecture for new product introductions
  • Optimizing test coverage and cycle time
  • Ensuring compliance with quality standards and achieving cost and delivery targets
  • Ensuring compliance with environmental aspects and targets
  • Preparation of all necessary documents for production: work instructions, process instructions, etc. according to the valid procedure
  • Risk assessment and limitation (FMEA, capability analysis,..)
  • Industrialization of production processes, cooperation with the development department in creating D-FMEA
  • Industrialization and validation of software for new model lines of manufactured products in cooperation with R&D
  • CIP (Continuous Improvement Process): Develop and implement improvements

Requirements

  • Education in the field of electronics, automotive electronics, electrical engineering, automation technologies or similar
  • English language - active (oral and written)
  • Knowledge of automotive tools (SPC, FMEA, 8D, PPAP,...)
  • Basic knowledge of quality management systems (ISO TS16949)
  • Ability to work in a team
  • Interest in new technologies
  • Knowledge of the architecture of AOI, AXI, ICT, OBP, FCT, EOL testing machines - ADVANTAGE
  • Basic knowledge of programming in C#, Labview - ADVANTAGE
  • Knowledge in the field of optics (production of camera systems) - ADVANTAGE

Awareness, Unity, Empowerment

At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.

AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure

As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.

Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making.

If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.

Regular / Permanent

title: Testing Engineer - Commisioning
description:
Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.

Your Key Responsibilities

We are looking for Testing Engineers in the field of eMobility, with a focus on commissioning test benches for products such as eAxles, hybrid modules and electric motors.

Are you passionate about controlling and testing eMobility products using cutting-edge test equipment? Do you enjoy programming, data analysis and implementing improvements for modern e-vehicle components?

If you are eager to develop your skills, learn new technologies, and work on innovative solutions, join our eMobility Testing Team in Slovakia!

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Leading the commissioning of complex eMobility test benches, including DUT integration, automation, and validation
  • Consultation of the results in a foreign language
  • Participate in technical meetings with customers or internal departments.
  • Track project deadlines, manage documentation, and ensure timely delivery of activities.

Your Qualifications

  • University degree (Master’s level) in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Mechanical Engineering with an electrical background.
  • Good command of English, both written and spoken; German language skills are a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with Vector CANoe/CANape and testing activities such as functional or durability testing.
  • Understanding of mechatronic systems including hybrid modules, e-axles, actuators, and drive systems.
  • Basic to advanced programming skills, especially scripting for automated data evaluation.
  • Analytical thinking and the ability to draw conclusions from complex test data.
  • Team player with a flexible mindset, strong self-motivation, and perseverance.

Welcome knowledge/certification/skills:

  • Experience with CANoe and CANape (Vector).
  • Hands-on experience or familiarity with measurement and testing tools such as Vector tools, DIAdem, IMC Studio, DEWESOFT, and dSPACE is an advantage.
  • Electrical qualification according to
  • 21.
  • Understanding of frequency converters and sensor systems.
  • Knowledge of automotive digital communication protocols, particularly CAN.
  • Openness to learning new tools and technologies.
  • High motivation for continuous education and professional growth.

Offered salary

1800-2700€/month - higher salary requirement can be considered based on previous experiences

Benefits

  • Working in a dynamic and challenging international environment
  • Stable post in an international company
  • Professional training – partly held in Germany
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Flexible working time (37,5 hrs./week)
  • Overtime compensation
  • Language courses (EN,DE,SK) covered by Schaeffler
  • 13th/14th salary
  • Referral and relocation bonus
  • Improvement bonus
  • Company contribution to pension system – 3% of gross base salary
  • Rich social program

As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.

Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.

description:
Hello,

We are called People More because we treat our employees with respect, but also because the projects we work on are for people and should be easy and pleasant to use. We are technological, but we look at the bigger picture :)

The company is made up of people with a huge client base in the country and abroad, for whom we build projects from scratch (UX, UI, frontend, backend, mobile) or in part. title: Robot Programmer(COMAU)
description:
COMAU Robot Programmer / Automation TechnicianJOB SUMMARY

The COMAU Robot Programmer / Automation Technician is responsible for supporting and maintaining automated robotic welding systems within a high-volume manufacturing environment. This role focuses on robot troubleshooting, production support, program modifications, weld process optimization, and minimizing equipment downtime. The technician will work with robotic welding cells, automated fixtures, PLC-controlled systems, and related automation equipment to ensure safe and efficient production operations.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Provide production support for automated robotic welding cells and robotic manufacturing systems
  • Troubleshoot and recover COMAU robots from faults, alarms, crashes, and production interruptions while restoring systems to operational status quickly and safely
  • Modify, optimize, and troubleshoot COMAU robot programs for welding and material handling applications
  • Perform robot touch-ups, TCP verification, path corrections, and position adjustments
  • Support robotic applications including MIG welding, resistance welding, projection welding, and pneumatic systems
  • Diagnose and repair electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and robotic system issues
  • Troubleshoot automated welding cells to identify root causes and implement corrective actions that reduce downtime and improve reliability
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, weld prints, and technical documentation
  • Troubleshoot and repair:
    • Servo drive systems
    • Motors and encoders
    • Relays and control boards
    • Sensors and safety devices
    • Wiring harnesses and electrical panels
  • Perform minor fixture adjustments, shim modifications, and weld tooling corrections based on manufacturing requirements
  • Support and maintain communication networks including Ethernet, Remote I/O, and DeviceNet systems
  • Perform basic offline programming and simulation using COMAU programming software and robotic simulation tools
  • Support integration and troubleshooting of PLC-controlled automation systems
  • Assist with robotic startup activities, program validation, and production launches
  • Ensure compliance with all customer, plant, and safety procedures while working around robotic and automated equipment
  • Maintain detailed documentation of repairs, troubleshooting activities, and process improvements
  • Communicate equipment concerns, downtime issues, and shift updates effectively with supervisors and team members
  • Work independently with minimal supervision while supporting production requirements
REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience troubleshooting and programming COMAU robotic systems in an industrial manufacturing environment
  • Strong understanding of robotic welding processes and welding fundamentals
  • Knowledge of:
    • Robotics and automation systems
    • Electrical circuitry and controls
    • Pneumatics and hydraulics
    • Industrial mechanics
    • Servo systems and automation components
  • Ability to troubleshoot electrical systems using schematics and prints
  • Experience with:
    • TCP setup and verification
    • I/O troubleshooting and simulation
    • Program touch-ups and path modifications
    • Weld process troubleshooting
    • Robot recovery procedures
  • Understanding of automated weld fixtures and shimming processes
  • Familiarity with PLC-controlled manufacturing equipment
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and respond effectively in a fast-paced production environment
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Industrial Maintenance, Electrician Journeyman, Mechatronics, or Machine Repair certification
  • Associate degree in Mechatronics, Robotics, Automation, Electrical Technology, or related field
  • Previous experience supporting robotic welding systems in automotive or automated manufacturing environments
  • Experience with offline robotic programming and simulation software
  • Strong electrical and mechanical troubleshooting background
WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL DEMANDS
  • Frequent exposure to noise, sparks, smoke, heat, dirt, grease, oil, and welding fumes
  • Regularly works around automated robotic equipment and high-speed production machinery
  • Exposure to high and low voltage electrical systems
  • Frequent walking, bending, twisting, lifting, and entering robotic weld cells
  • Required use of PPE including eye protection, hearing protection, gloves, and cut-resistant equipment
  • Potential exposure to Arc Flash hazards while working in electrical cabinets and control panels
BEHAVIORAL EXPECTATIONS
  • Demonstrates accountability, reliability, and strong attention to detail
  • Maintains a high sense of urgency while supporting production needs
  • Works effectively both independently and within a team environment
  • Communicates professionally with supervisors, maintenance personnel, and production teams
  • Adapts positively to changing production priorities and plant requirements
  • Maintains strong attendance and dependability
  • Focuses on continuous improvement, safety, and equipment reliability

Why Rolls-Royce?
